900/42
8 12 41

December 7, 41.

Dear Sir,

In reply to your letter dated December
2, 1941, I forward herewith copy of a Police report
regarding Heinrich Mayer and fourteen other persons.

Yours faithfully,

E. Jones for
Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch).

Immigration Officer,
American Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Original sent 8-11-41

INDEXED BY
(S.B.) REGISTRY
DATE 8/12/41
